assistant.assistantTurnErrorNoReply: The assistant didn't come up with a reply. Try rephrasing your request.
assistant.assistantUnavailableInsufficientMemory: This device doesn't have enough memory to run the assistant's model.
assistant.assistantUnavailableUnsupportedBrowser: The assistant's model needs graphics features that aren't available here.

desktop.lockDescription: Enter your PIN to unlock. Background sync and drives keep running while Filen is locked.
desktop.lockFailed: Couldn't check the PIN. Try again.
desktop.lockRetryIn: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{time}}.
desktop.lockSignOutBody: Signing out removes the PIN and Filen's data on this device, including changes that haven't synced yet. Sign in again with your password.
desktop.lockUnreadable: Filen couldn't read its PIN. Unlock your system keychain and try again, or sign out.
desktop.pinRemoveDescription: Enter your PIN to stop locking Filen.
desktop.pinRulesDescription: Use {{min}} to {{max}} digits. A forgotten PIN can only be removed by signing out.
desktop.pinWaitingForSecureStorage: Your PIN is kept in this computer's keychain or keyring, which Filen can't use right now. Unlock it and restart Filen to use your PIN.
desktop.sessionDiscardBody: The saved sign-in will be removed from this device. Files in your account are not affected. Credentials saved for your servers may need to be entered again.
desktop.sessionDiscardFailed: Couldn't remove the saved sign-in. Try again.
desktop.sessionUnreadableBody: The saved sign-in could not be read. Unlock your system keychain and try again, or sign in again.
desktop.sessionUnreadableStill: Still couldn't read it. Check that your system keychain is unlocked.
desktop.settingsLockNowDescription: Lock Filen until the PIN is entered. You can also lock it from its tray or menu bar icon.
desktop.settingsLockPinDescription: Ask for a PIN when Filen opens and after it hasn't been used for a while. Background sync and drives keep running while Filen is locked.
desktop.settingsLockPinWaiting: Your PIN is kept in this computer's keychain or keyring, which Filen can't use right now. Unlock it and restart Filen to use your PIN. A new PIN can't be set until then.
desktop.settingsLogsExportDescription: Save the app's diagnostic logs to a file you can send to support. Keys, passwords and other secrets are removed.
desktop.updateReadyBody: Filen {{version}} has been downloaded. Restart to install it.

sync.activityEmptyDescription: What Filen syncs while it runs shows up here.
sync.addLocalDescription: Choose the directory to keep in sync.
sync.addModeDescription: Choose how changes move between the two directories. You can change this later.
sync.addRemoteDescription: Open the directory in your Cloud Drive to sync with, or choose your whole drive. Double-click a directory to open it.
sync.addRemotePickNone: Open a directory to sync with, or choose your whole drive.
sync.addRemoteWholeDriveWarning: The first sync lists your entire drive, which can take a long time and a lot of memory.
sync.backlogAdoptDestinationDescription: The kept copies stay where they are and are not deleted or copied back to the source.
sync.backlogDescription: As a backup, this pair kept copies in the destination of files you deleted from the source. What should happen to them?
sync.backlogPropagateDescription: The destination matches the source after the next sync. Large deletions still ask first.
sync.conflictKeptBothAs: Kept both; this device's version is {{path}}
sync.conflictKeptRemoteBinned: Kept the cloud's version. This device's version is in the pair's bin: {{path}}
sync.conflictLocalDeleted: Deleted on this device, changed in the cloud
sync.conflictRemoteDeleted: Deleted in the cloud, changed on this device
sync.conflictRuleFileHint: This is the pair's .filenignore. Its copy on this device was never uploaded while the pair only downloaded; keep both to merge the rules by hand.
sync.conflictsKeepAllBothBody_one: Both versions of {{count}} item are kept, this device's under a new name.
sync.conflictsKeepAllBothBody_other: Both versions of {{count}} items are kept, this device's under a new name.
sync.conflictsKeepAllLocalBody_one: This device's version replaces the cloud's for {{count}} item.
sync.conflictsKeepAllLocalBody_other: This device's version replaces the cloud's for {{count}} items.
sync.conflictsKeepAllRemoteBody_one: The cloud's version replaces this device's for {{count}} item. This device's version goes to the pair's bin.
sync.conflictsKeepAllRemoteBody_other: The cloud's version replaces this device's for {{count}} items. This device's versions go to the pair's bin.
sync.conflictsKeptAllLocal_one: Kept this device's version of {{count}} item.
sync.conflictsKeptAllLocal_other: Kept this device's version of {{count}} items.
sync.conflictsKeptAllRemote_one: Kept the cloud's version of {{count}} item. This device's version is in the pair's bin.
sync.conflictsKeptAllRemote_other: Kept the cloud's version of {{count}} items. This device's versions are in the pair's bin.
sync.detailDegradedLocal: Filen can't watch this directory for changes, so it checks it every few minutes instead.
sync.detailDegradedRemote: Filen can't follow changes in the cloud directory live, so it checks it every few minutes instead.
sync.detailMissingTitle: This sync pair no longer exists
sync.detailSelectPromptDescription: Its activity, issues and settings show here.
sync.detailWaitingForRoot: The directory on this device is missing. Filen starts syncing it again once it's back.
sync.errorLocalRootContains: This directory contains another sync pair's directory.
sync.errorLocalRootInUse: Another sync pair already uses this directory.
sync.errorLocalRootMissing: The directory on this device is missing.
sync.errorLocalRootNested: This directory is inside another sync pair's directory.
sync.errorModeConflict: The pair can't switch to this mode right now.
sync.errorPairNotFound: This sync pair no longer exists.
sync.errorPlanExpired: This preview expired. Try again to refresh it.
sync.errorRemoteRootContains: This cloud directory contains another sync pair's cloud directory.
sync.errorRemoteRootInUse: Another sync pair already uses this cloud directory.
sync.errorRemoteRootMissing: The cloud directory no longer exists.
sync.errorRemoteRootNested: This cloud directory is inside another sync pair's cloud directory.
sync.errorResolutionRefused: In this sync mode, this choice can't resolve a conflict between a file and a directory. Choose another.
sync.errorRootExpired: The chosen directory expired. Choose it again.
sync.errorTimeout: Sync didn't answer in time. Try again.
sync.errorUnauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
sync.findingConflicts: Some items changed on both sides.
sync.findingDownloads: It downloads more than a few small files.
sync.findingOverwrites: It overwrites a lot of files already on the other side.
sync.findingRefused: It can't sync as it is.
sync.findingUnconverged: Filen hadn't fully read the cloud directory yet.
sync.findingUploads: It uploads more than a few small files.
sync.haltCertificateUnverified: A secure connection to Filen couldn't be verified. A proxy or security software may be intercepting it, or this device is missing a certificate it needs. It syncs again once the connection can be verified.
sync.haltLocalStorageFull: This device is out of space, so Filen held back what it would write.
sync.haltOffline: Filen can't reach the server right now. It syncs again once it can.
sync.haltRemoteStorageFull: Your Filen storage is full, so Filen held back what it would upload.
sync.heldApproveBody_one: {{count}} item is deleted on the other side. This device's deletions go to the pair's bin, the cloud's to the cloud trash.
sync.heldApproveBody_other: {{count}} items are deleted on the other side. This device's deletions go to the pair's bin, the cloud's to the cloud trash.
sync.heldExceededThreshold: Filen held these deletions because there are unusually many at once.
sync.heldFirstSyncWithDeletions: Filen held these deletions because they're part of this pair's first sync.
sync.heldRemoteEmptied: Filen held these deletions because the cloud directory was emptied.
sync.heldRemoteUnconverged: Filen held these deletions because it hadn't fully read the cloud directory.
sync.heldRestoreBody_one: {{count}} item deleted on one side is put back from the other side's copy, so it stays on both. Nothing is deleted.
sync.heldRestoreBody_other: {{count}} items deleted on one side are put back from the other side's copy, so they stay on both. Nothing is deleted.
sync.heldRestoreUnfinished: Filen held these deletions because putting back the items you kept hasn't finished. Keep them to try again, or approve the deletions.
sync.heldRestored: Keeping them. Filen puts them back on the side they were deleted from.
sync.heldScanIncomplete: Filen held these deletions because a scan didn't finish.
sync.holdCloudListingSlow: Still reading this directory in the cloud. Large directories can take a while; syncing starts on its own once it's read.
sync.holdDriveRoot: This pair syncs your whole drive, which can take a long time and a lot of memory. It starts when you start it.
sync.holdRuleFileUndecodable: This pair's .filenignore isn't UTF-8 text, so Filen can't add the ignore rules the pair had in the previous app. Save it as UTF-8, then try again.
sync.holdRuleFileUnwritable: Filen can't write the ignore rules this pair had in the previous app to its .filenignore, so the pair waits. Make the directory writable, then try again.
sync.hostAddonMissing: Sync can't run because part of Filen is missing. Reinstall Filen if this keeps happening.
sync.hostBaselineInUse: Another copy of Filen is using this account's sync data. Quit it and try again.
sync.hostCrashLoop: Sync kept stopping unexpectedly, so Filen turned it off.
sync.hostKeychainLocked: Filen couldn't read your session from the system keychain. Unlock it and try again.
sync.hostRestarting: Sync stopped unexpectedly and restarts shortly.
sync.ignoredDescription: These paths aren't synced because a rule matches them.
sync.importNoteDropped_one: {{count}} pair from the previous version couldn't be read.
sync.importNoteDropped_other: {{count}} pairs from the previous version couldn't be read.
sync.importNoteMerged_one: {{count}} duplicate pair from the previous version was merged.
sync.importNoteMerged_other: {{count}} duplicate pairs from the previous version were merged.
sync.infoLocalTrashNowOn: Files this pair replaces or deletes on this device now go to its bin first, where they stay for 30 days. The previous app deleted them right away.
sync.issuesConflictsDescription: These changed on both sides. Choose which version to keep.
sync.issuesEmptyDescription: Conflicts, held deletions and items that can't be synced show up here.
sync.issuesFailed_one: {{count}} item failed in the last sync. Filen tries it again in the next one.
sync.issuesFailed_other: {{count}} items failed in the last sync. Filen tries them again in the next one.
sync.modeLocalBackupDescription: Files on this device are copied to the cloud. Nothing is ever deleted in the cloud.
sync.modeLocalToRemoteDescription: Changes on this device sync to the cloud. Changes in the cloud stay there.
sync.modeRemoteBackupDescription: Files in the cloud are copied to this device. Nothing is ever deleted on this device.
sync.modeRemoteToLocalDescription: Changes in the cloud sync to this device. Changes on this device stay here.
sync.modeTwoWayDescription: Changes on either side sync to the other, deletions too.
sync.noticeRefusedLocalOverlap: Filen can't sync this pair: its directory on this device is, contains or is inside another pair's directory.
sync.noticeRefusedLocalRoot: Filen can't sync this pair from the previous app: its directory on this device can't be synced. Add it again with another directory.
sync.noticeRefusedModeConflict: Filen can't sync this pair: another pair syncs the same directories in another mode.
sync.noticeRefusedRemoteMissing: Filen can't sync this pair from the previous app: its cloud directory no longer exists. Add it again with another cloud directory.
sync.noticeRefusedRemoteOverlap: Filen can't sync this pair: its cloud directory is, contains or is inside another pair's cloud directory.
sync.noticeRefusedWholeDrive: Filen can't sync this pair from the previous app: it syncs your whole drive, which overlaps your other pairs. Remove it, or remove the other pairs and add it again.
sync.problemAppData: Directories that apps keep their data in can't be synced.
sync.problemContainsMount: This directory contains a Filen network drive.
sync.problemContainsPair: This directory contains another sync pair's directory.
sync.problemFilesystemRoot: A whole drive can't be synced. Choose a directory on it.
sync.problemHomeDirectory: Your home directory can't be synced. Choose a directory inside it.
sync.problemInsideMount: This directory is inside a Filen network drive.
sync.problemInsidePair: This directory is inside another sync pair's directory.
sync.problemNotWritable: Filen can't write to this directory.
sync.refusedLocalCollision: Two items in this directory would get the same name in the cloud. Rename one of them first.
sync.refusedRemoteCollision: Two items in the cloud directory would get the same name on this device. Rename one of them first.
sync.removeBody: Filen stops syncing this pair. The files stay on this device and in the cloud.
sync.reviewDescriptionBaselineReset: Filen had to rebuild this pair's sync state, so it kept the pair paused until you check its next sync.
sync.reviewDescriptionMigrated: Filen brought this pair over from the previous desktop app and kept it paused, because its first sync would replace a lot of what is already on the other side.
sync.reviewDescriptionNew: This is what the first sync does. Nothing changes until you start it.
sync.reviewLarge: This sync makes {{formatted}} changes. It can take a long time and use a lot of bandwidth.
sync.reviewTitleBaselineReset: Check this pair before it starts again
sync.reviewTitleMigrated: Check this pair before it starts
sync.reviewUnconverged: Filen is still reading the cloud directory, so what the first sync does isn't known yet.
sync.scanGapsTitle: Not read in the last scan
sync.settingsBinDescription: Items the sync replaces or deletes on this device are filed by date in .filen-sync-trash in the pair's directory and deleted permanently after 30 days.
sync.settingsPauseDescription: A paused pair keeps its state and catches up when it resumes.
sync.settingsRemoveDescription: Stop syncing these directories. The files stay on both sides.
sync.settingsSyncNowDescription: Check both sides for changes right away.
sync.skippedSymlinksDescription: Synced once under their real path.
sync.syncEmptyDescription: Keep a directory on this device and one in the cloud the same.
sync.unsyncableInvalidName: Its name isn't allowed in the cloud.
sync.unsyncableLocalNameCollision: Another item in its directory on this device has the same name when case is ignored. Rename one of them; until then neither syncs or moves.
sync.unsyncableRemoteBrokenParent: The cloud directory it's in can't be read.
sync.unsyncableRemoteContentHashMismatch: Its cloud content doesn't match its stored checksum, so it isn't downloaded until it changes.
sync.unsyncableRemoteInvalidName: Its cloud name isn't allowed on this device.
sync.unsyncableRemoteNameCollision: Another item in its cloud directory has the same name when case and Unicode form are ignored. Rename one of them; until then neither syncs or moves.
sync.unsyncableRemoteNameNotStorable: Its cloud name can't be stored on this device.
sync.unsyncableRemoteUndecodable: The cloud item can't be decrypted.
sync.unsyncableRepeatedFailure: It failed several times in a row.
sync.userIgnoreDescription: Applies to every sync pair on this device. One rule per line, written like a .gitignore.
sync.warningCloudStorage: Another cloud storage app syncs this directory. Both apps would sync its files, which can cause conflicts.
sync.warningICloud: This directory is in iCloud Drive. iCloud and Filen would both sync its files, which can cause conflicts.
sync.warningOneDrive: This directory is in OneDrive. OneDrive and Filen would both sync its files, which can cause conflicts.

mounts.cacheClearBody: The drive and running servers stop for a moment while the cache is cleared. Files in the cloud are not touched.
mounts.cacheClearDescription: Removes the copies kept on this device for speed. Files in the cloud are not touched.
mounts.cacheClearPending: Can't be cleared while files are waiting to upload.
mounts.cacheErrored_one: {{count}} file couldn't be uploaded. Filen keeps it and tries again.
mounts.cacheErrored_other: {{count}} files couldn't be uploaded. Filen keeps them and tries again.
mounts.cachePending_one: {{count}} file still has to reach the cloud. Keep Filen open until it does.
mounts.cachePending_other: {{count}} files still have to reach the cloud. Keep Filen open until they do.
mounts.connectHintFtp: Use an FTP client with the user name and password below.
mounts.connectHintHttp: Open the address in a browser to browse and download files, with the user name and password below.
mounts.connectHintNfs: Mount the address with your system's NFS client.
mounts.connectHintRestic: Use the address as the restic repository, with the user name and password below.
mounts.connectHintS3: Use path-style requests with the access key below. Any region name works.
mounts.connectHintSftp: Use an SFTP client with the user name and password below. Keys are not accepted.
mounts.connectHintWebdav: Use a WebDAV client or your file manager's "Connect to server" with the user name and password below.
mounts.credentialsCustomDescription: Clients using the current credentials must sign in with these.
mounts.credentialsCustomDescriptionS3: Clients using the current keys must sign in with these. The access key ID is 16 to 128 letters and digits.
mounts.credentialsCustomHint: At least 12 characters, not easy to guess, without ":" or ",".
mounts.credentialsCustomRowDescription: Pick the user name and password clients sign in with.
mounts.credentialsRegenerateBody: The current ones stop working. Clients using them must sign in with the new ones.
mounts.credentialsRegenerateDescription: Replaces them with new random ones.
mounts.credentialsRevealDescription: Shown on this page until you leave it.
mounts.driveEnableDescription: Your Filen drive shows up as a disk on this device. Changes upload in the background.
mounts.driveLetterDefault: The first free letter from X down.
mounts.driveLetterDescription: The letter the drive shows up under in File Explorer.
mounts.driveReadOnlyDescription: Files can be opened but not changed.
mounts.driveReadOnlyLocked: Turn the drive off to change this.
mounts.errorAcknowledgementRequired: Confirm that the server may run without sign-in.
mounts.errorAddressUnavailable: The server can't listen on that address.
mounts.errorAuthRequired: The server needs credentials to run.
mounts.errorBinaryInvalid: Part of Filen is missing or damaged. Reinstall Filen.
mounts.errorCredentialsInvalid: These credentials can't be used. Avoid ":" and ","; an S3 access key ID is 16 to 128 letters and digits.
mounts.errorCredentialsWeak: That password is too easy to guess. Use at least 12 characters and avoid the user name.
mounts.errorDaemonUnstable: The drive and servers kept stopping unexpectedly. Try again.
mounts.errorDriveLetterInUse: That drive letter is in use. Choose another one.
mounts.errorDriveUnmounted: The drive was unmounted outside Filen. Try again to mount it.
mounts.errorFuseMissing: The drive can't be mounted because the file system driver is missing.
mounts.errorHostUnavailable: The Filen helper isn't running. Try again in a moment.
mounts.errorMountPointExpired: That choice has expired. Choose the mount point again.
mounts.errorMountPointInvalid: That directory can't be the mount point.
mounts.errorMountPointNotEmpty: The mount point must be an empty directory.
mounts.errorPortInUse: That port is in use. Choose another one.
mounts.errorTimeout: That took too long. Try again.
mounts.errorUnauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
mounts.errorUnsupportedProtocol: This isn't available on this device.
mounts.errorUploadsPending: Files are still waiting to upload. Try again once they're done.
mounts.finderDescription: Your Filen drive appears in Finder under Locations. Files download when you open them.
mounts.finderErrorNoSession: Filen couldn't read your session. Sign in again, then try again.
mounts.finderErrorNotFound: Filen isn't showing in Finder yet. Try again in a moment.
mounts.finderErrorUnsupported: Filen in Finder needs macOS 14 or later.
mounts.finderLockBlocked: Filen in Finder is off while an app lock PIN is set, so your files can't be opened without it.
mounts.finderNeedsEnabling: Switch on Filen in System Settings, under General > Login Items & Extensions, to see it in Finder.
mounts.finderNotRegistered: Filen couldn't add itself to Finder. Turn Filen in Finder off and on again.
mounts.finderOpenDescription: Browse your Filen drive in Finder.
mounts.finderRecommended: Filen in Finder is recommended on this Mac; the network drive stays available for apps that need a mounted drive.
mounts.finderTranslocated: Move Filen to Applications first, then open it from there to use Filen in Finder.
mounts.fuseInstallRebootRequired: WinFsp is installed. Restart your computer to mount the drive.
mounts.fuseMissing: The drive can't be mounted on this system. The servers still work.
mounts.fuseMissingDevice: This system has no FUSE device (/dev/fuse), as in a container or sandbox, so the drive can't be mounted here. The servers still work.
mounts.fuseMissingFuse3: Mounting the drive needs the fuse3 package. Install it with your package manager, then try again.
mounts.fuseMissingInstallable: Mounting the drive needs WinFsp, which isn't installed.
mounts.hostAddonMissing: The drive and servers can't run because part of Filen is missing. Reinstall Filen if this keeps happening.
mounts.hostBaselineInUse: Another copy of Filen is using this account's data. Quit it and try again.
mounts.hostCrashLoop: The Filen helper kept stopping unexpectedly, so Filen turned it off.
mounts.hostKeychainLocked: Filen couldn't read your session from the system keychain. Unlock it and try again.
mounts.hostRestarting: The Filen helper stopped unexpectedly and restarts shortly.
mounts.httpsOffBody: The server listens on {{address}}. Without HTTPS, credentials travel in plain text and anyone on the network can read them and your files.
mounts.noticeAddressInvalid: A server's address from the previous version of Filen can't be used any more, so the server is off. Choose an address to run it again.
mounts.noticeCertificateRegenerated: A server's HTTPS certificate was made anew. Clients that trusted the old one must trust the new one.
mounts.noticeCredentialsRegenerated: Some servers' credentials from the previous version of Filen couldn't be kept, so Filen made new ones. Clients using the old credentials must sign in with the new ones.
mounts.noticeLegacyCacheErrored: Some files from the previous version of Filen couldn't be uploaded. Filen keeps them and tries again on the next start.
mounts.noticeLegacyUploadsPending: Files from the previous version of Filen are still uploading. Keep Filen open until they are done.
mounts.noticeMountPointInvalid: The network drive's old mount point can't be used any more, so the drive is off. Choose a new one to mount it.
mounts.problemHomeDirectory: It can't be your home directory itself.
mounts.problemOutsideHome: It has to be inside your home directory.
mounts.problemSymlink: It's a link to another location.
mounts.problemTemporary: It's in a temporary location the system may empty.
mounts.serveAddressNfs: NFS has no sign-in, so it only listens on this device.
mounts.serveCredentialsDescription: Clients sign in with these. They are only for this server, never your Filen password.
mounts.serveHttpsDescription: Encrypts connections with a certificate made on this device.
mounts.servePlainText: This server listens on your network without HTTPS, so credentials and files travel in plain text.
mounts.serveReadOnlyDescription: Clients can open files but not change them.
mounts.serveUnauthenticated: {{protocol}} has no sign-in. Anyone on this device can use the server while it runs.
mounts.serveUrlOff: Shown once the server is on.
mounts.tuningDescription: These apply to the network drive and every server. Running ones restart to use them.
mounts.tuningMinFree: Space to keep free on the disk (GiB)
mounts.tuningRowDescription: Size, age and refresh of the cache the drive and every server share.
mounts.unauthenticatedBody: {{protocol}} has no sign-in. While it runs, any app or user on this device can read and change your Filen drive through it.
mounts.unavailable: The drive and servers can't run because part of Filen is missing or damaged. Reinstall Filen.
